tagline: Pioneering allogeneic CAR-T cell therapies with best-in-class gene editing
hero_kpi_rationale: Cash is the key KPI because Cellectis is a pre-revenue biotech company with a model based on pipeline development and partnerships. Cash position determines runway and ability to reach next clinical milestones.

kpis.description: The company holds $211M in cash as of December 31, 2025, including $144.8M in term deposits and $4.4M in restricted cash.
kpis.signal: Sufficient cash to fund operations through H2 2027.

risks.title: Single supplier dependence on alemtuzumab
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in the 10-K, strong language on potential impact, stable trend, critical category for clinical manufacturing.

risks.title: Intense competition in immuno-oncology
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K, alarming language regarding competitors' superior resources, stable trend, high weight due to market share loss risk.

risks.title: Strict regulation of gene therapies
risks.score_rationale: Repeatedly present, very cautious language, stable trend, high weight due to direct impact on approval and commercialization.

risks.title: Dependence on gene editing technology
risks.score_rationale: Central risk in document, strong language on total dependence, stable trend, critical weight as foundational to business.

risks.title: Intellectual property risks
risks.score_rationale: Frequent mention, concerned language on potential litigation, stable trend, high weight due to technology protection stakes.

risks.title: Manufacturing scale-up challenges
risks.score_rationale: Clear mention in operational risks, cautionary language, stable trend, high weight for commercialization.

risks.title: Dependence on strategic partnerships
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention regarding Servier and AstraZeneca, concerned language on dependencies, stable trend, high weight for clinical development.

risks.title: Market hesitancy toward CAR-T adoption
risks.score_rationale: Present in commercial risks, measured but concerned language, stable trend, moderate weight but rising.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in provided documents. Cellectis innovation relies on TALEN gene editing and allogeneic CAR-T development, with no reference to AI.
evidence: No mention of AI, machine learning or algorithms in corporate presentation
